notice: Every statement here is synthetic and carries an evidence class. Industry material is a pattern until a customer confirms it. Customer material is a public signal until the customer confirms it. Nothing here is a measured outcome.

industryContext.name: Intelligent workplace & smart buildings
industryContext.definition: Organisations that run a corporate property estate as a cost base and as a place of work, where occupancy, energy and service quality all affect the result.
industryContext.scopeNotes: Covers corporate offices and mixed-use campuses. Excludes data centres and industrial sites.

pressures.statement: Desk supply often exceeds observed demand after hybrid working settled.
Occupancy, energy and service data sit with different owners, so portfolio decisions are taken without a joined view.
Published decarbonisation commitments create a reporting obligation that competes with cost reduction.

industryValueStreams.name: Plan and supply workspace
industryValueStreams.description: How an estate decides how much space to hold, where, and on what lease terms.

industryValueStreams.name: Operate the building day to day
industryValueStreams.description: How heating, cooling, lighting and services are scheduled against real use.

industryValueStreams.name: Serve the workforce
industryValueStreams.description: How workplace services are requested, prioritised and resolved.

industryValueStreams.name: Report and govern
industryValueStreams.description: How cost, carbon and risk positions are evidenced for the board and for external reporting.

customerReportExtracts.statement: Property cost reduction is named as a multi-year priority.
The workplace is described as a lever for attracting and retaining people under hybrid working.
A decarbonisation commitment with interim milestones is restated.

customerValueStreams.name: Estate footprint decision
customerValueStreams.description: Deciding which floors and buildings to hold, sublet or release, using observed demand rather than headcount alone.
frictions: Demand evidence is held per building, not per portfolio
Lease events force decisions before evidence is ready
opportunities: Build one demand picture before the next lease break
Agree a utilisation threshold that triggers review
capabilityNeeds: Consented occupancy aggregation
A shared portfolio baseline
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: Workplace strategy advisory can run the baseline; the customer owns the decision.
validationQuestions: Who owns the portfolio cost line, and what baseline do they already accept?
Which occupancy data may be used, at what aggregation, under which agreement?

customerValueStreams.name: Plant scheduling against real use
customerValueStreams.valueStreamStage: Operate the building day to day
customerValueStreams.description: Matching heating and cooling schedules to observed occupancy instead of fixed calendars.
frictions: Schedules are changed by hand and drift back
Comfort complaints are not joined to schedule changes
opportunities: Review occupied hours against the plant schedule
Propose a reviewed schedule for human approval
capabilityNeeds: Read-only access to plant and meter history
A change route that keeps a human in control
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: FM or energy services partner would hold the change and the comfort risk.
validationQuestions: Who may change a plant schedule today, and what approval does that need?
What comfort and safety overrides must always win?

customerValueStreams.name: Workplace service response
customerValueStreams.description: How a reported workplace fault becomes a prioritised, resolved and confirmed piece of work.
signals: Repeat tickets in the same space
frictions: Repeat faults are closed as separate tickets
Experience feedback is not linked to the asset
opportunities: Group repeat faults by space before despatch
Record the experience effect alongside the fix
capabilityNeeds: Ticket and room data joined by a stable space identifier
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: Managed experience provider usually holds the service level.
validationQuestions: Is there one space identifier shared by the booking, ticket and asset systems?
Which experience measure does the business already trust?

customerValueStreams.name: Cost and carbon reporting
customerValueStreams.description: Producing the cost and carbon position that the board and external reporting rely on.
frictions: Figures are rebuilt by hand each cycle
Estimates are not separated from measured readings
opportunities: Separate measured from estimated at source
Agree one evidence trail per reported figure
capabilityNeeds: Lineage from reading to reported figure
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: Assurance or advisory partner may review the method, not the result.
validationQuestions: Which reported figures are currently estimated rather than measured?
Who signs the carbon position, and against which standard?

organisation.structureNote: Function names are taken from the supplied design pack. The reporting lines between them are an assumption until an organisation chart is shared.

functions.name: CFO / Finance
functions.accountability: Owns the property cost line and the investment case.
validationQuestions: Who inside finance owns the estate cost line day to day?

functions.name: Corporate real estate
functions.accountability: Holds the lease portfolio and the space plan.
validationQuestions: Is space planning run centrally or per region?

functions.name: HR / Workplace
functions.accountability: Owns the workplace experience and attendance policy.
validationQuestions: Which experience measure is already reported to the executive?

functions.name: Facilities / Energy
functions.accountability: Runs plant, energy and the maintenance route.
validationQuestions: Is facilities delivered in-house or by a service provider?

functions.name: CIO / Security
functions.accountability: Owns data access, network and security approval.
validationQuestions: What approval route governs building data leaving its original system?

openQuestions: What would make this baseline credible to audit?
validationQuestions: Is the CFO the decision owner, or a finance director below them?

openQuestions: Which lease events fall in the next four quarters?
validationQuestions: Who signs a release decision?

openQuestions: Does space change help or harm the experience measure?
validationQuestions: Is there a named experience owner, or is it shared with HR?

openQuestions: What schedule change is allowed without a formal change request?
validationQuestions: Does an external FM provider hold this authority instead?

openQuestions: What aggregation makes occupancy data acceptable?
validationQuestions: Which data protection assessment applies to occupancy data here?

unknowns.unknown: No customer baseline for cost per m² or kWh per occupied hour.
unknowns.validationQuestion: Which baseline figures will finance accept, and for which period?

unknowns.unknown: Data access rights for occupancy and plant history are unconfirmed.
unknowns.validationQuestion: What approval is needed to read occupancy and plant data, and at what aggregation?

unknowns.unknown: The named executive sponsor is unknown.
unknowns.validationQuestion: Who sponsors this work and owns the outcome?

unknowns.unknown: Facilities delivery model is unconfirmed, in-house or outsourced.
unknowns.validationQuestion: Who holds the maintenance and plant change authority today?

aiUseCases.name: Demand pattern summary for a lease review
aiUseCases.raiNotes: Occupancy data can identify individuals if not aggregated. Aggregation thresholds must be agreed first.
aiUseCases.humanInTheLoop: A real estate lead accepts or rejects every summary.
aiUseCases.nextValidationAction: Agree the aggregation level and run one building as a paper exercise.

aiUseCases.name: Schedule mismatch explanation
aiUseCases.raiNotes: Must never issue a plant command. Comfort and safety overrides sit above any recommendation.
aiUseCases.humanInTheLoop: Facilities approval is required before any schedule change is drafted.
aiUseCases.nextValidationAction: Confirm the approval route and keep the agent to a drafted recommendation.

aiUseCases.name: Repeat fault grouping
aiUseCases.raiNotes: Operational text may contain personal detail; strip it before use.
aiUseCases.humanInTheLoop: The service desk keeps the grouping decision.
aiUseCases.nextValidationAction: Test the grouping against one quarter of closed tickets.

partnerRoles.name: Workplace strategy advisory
partnerRoles.role: Runs the demand baseline and the business case.
partnerRoles.validationQuestion: Is an advisory partner already engaged on the estate plan?

partnerRoles.name: SI and OT integration partner
partnerRoles.role: Joins building, booking and network data under an agreed pattern.

partnerRoles.name: FM or managed experience provider
partnerRoles.role: Holds the service level and the change route.
partnerRoles.validationQuestion: Which provider holds the current FM contract and when does it renew?

industryContext.name: Retail stores & omnichannel operations
industryContext.definition: Store estates where sales, service cost, stock loss and energy all move together, and where online orders are fulfilled from the same floor.
industryContext.scopeNotes: Covers physical stores and in-store fulfilment. Excludes pure e-commerce and distribution centres.

pressures.statement: Store margin is squeezed between service cost, energy cost and in-store fulfilment labour.
Conversion, availability and refrigeration performance are owned by different teams on different cycles.
Chilled estate failures carry both waste cost and food safety exposure.

industryValueStreams.name: Convert footfall to sales
industryValueStreams.description: How a visit becomes a transaction and a repeat visit.

industryValueStreams.name: Keep stock available and safe
industryValueStreams.description: How availability and condition are maintained, including the chilled estate.

industryValueStreams.name: Fulfil omnichannel orders
industryValueStreams.description: How an online order is fulfilled from store stock and store labour.

industryValueStreams.name: Run the store estate
industryValueStreams.description: How multi-site assets and energy are managed centrally.

customerReportExtracts.statement: Same-store sales growth is named as the primary commercial measure.
A cost to serve programme covering store labour and energy is described.
Shrink, waste and energy intensity are reported together as responsibility measures.

customerValueStreams.name: Queue and service recovery
customerValueStreams.description: Spotting a service queue early enough to move staff before a visit is lost.
frictions: Footfall and till data are reviewed after the day ends
Staffing plans are fixed a week ahead
opportunities: Flag the gap during the trading day
Give the store a bounded staffing prompt
capabilityNeeds: Aggregated footfall counting
A prompt route the store already uses
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: Retail analytics specialist usually supplies the counting method.
validationQuestions: Is footfall counted consistently across the estate?
Who may change staffing inside the trading day?

customerValueStreams.name: Chilled estate condition response
customerValueStreams.description: Turning a refrigeration anomaly into a prioritised engineer visit before stock is lost.
frictions: Alarms are frequent and often cleared without a cause
Repeat faults on one case are not grouped
opportunities: Rank anomalies by stock at risk
Draft a prioritised visit for a human to approve
capabilityNeeds: Read-only condition history
A work-order route with human approval
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: Refrigeration OEM and service partner hold the asset and the repair SLA.
validationQuestions: What food safety rule governs a temperature exception?
Who may raise a priority engineer visit?

customerValueStreams.name: Store fulfilment load
customerValueStreams.description: Understanding what in-store picking costs and when it competes with serving customers.
frictions: Picking labour is not separated from serving labour
Peak picking overlaps peak trading
opportunities: Separate the two labour lines in reporting
Test a different picking window in one store
capabilityNeeds: Order and rota data joined by store and hour
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: Store systems integrator typically joins order and rota data.
validationQuestions: Is picking labour already costed separately?
Which store would accept a controlled test?

customerValueStreams.name: Multi-site energy and loss reporting
customerValueStreams.description: Producing an estate view of energy intensity and loss that operations and finance both accept.
frictions: Site data arrives at different times
Outliers are explained locally and not recorded
opportunities: One ranked outlier list per week
Record the explanation against the site
capabilityNeeds: Consistent site identifiers
A single estate data set
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: Retail managed services partner may already produce part of this view.
validationQuestions: Does one estate data set already exist?
Who signs the loss position?

organisation.structureNote: Function names come from the supplied design pack. Store-level authority is an assumption until confirmed.

functions.name: Chief commercial officer
functions.accountability: Owns sales performance and the commercial plan.
validationQuestions: Is trading performance owned centrally or by region?

functions.name: Store operations
functions.accountability: Runs the stores and the labour model.
validationQuestions: What may a store manager change without regional approval?

functions.name: Merchandising
validationQuestions: Who arbitrates between availability and waste?

functions.name: Facilities / Energy
functions.accountability: Maintains refrigeration, plant and energy contracts.
validationQuestions: Is refrigeration maintenance in-house or with an OEM partner?

functions.name: Loss prevention / IT
functions.accountability: Owns shrink, store systems and data access.
validationQuestions: Which team approves access to store video or POS data?

openQuestions: Which stores carry the most service loss?
validationQuestions: Is the COO the sponsor for store change?

openQuestions: What prompt would actually be used on the shop floor?
validationQuestions: How many stores does one director hold?

openQuestions: Which assets fail most often and why?
validationQuestions: Does the OEM hold the priority decision instead?

openQuestions: Is loss driven by waste, theft or process?
validationQuestions: Who owns the shrink number in finance?

openQuestions: What evidence would justify an estate-wide change?
validationQuestions: Which finance partner covers store operations?

unknowns.unknown: No agreed baseline for conversion, waste or cost per collection.
unknowns.validationQuestion: Which store metrics does finance already sign off?

unknowns.unknown: Footfall counting consistency across the estate is unknown.
unknowns.validationQuestion: Is footfall counted the same way in every store format?
Who may raise and prioritise a refrigeration visit today?

unknowns.unknown: Food safety escalation rules are not documented here.
unknowns.validationQuestion: What must happen within what time after a temperature exception?

aiUseCases.name: Trading-day service gap prompt
aiUseCases.raiNotes: Must not profile individual staff performance. Store-level aggregation only.
aiUseCases.humanInTheLoop: The store manager decides whether to act on a prompt.
aiUseCases.nextValidationAction: Shadow one store for a week and compare the prompt with what the manager already knew.

aiUseCases.name: Refrigeration anomaly ranking
aiUseCases.raiNotes: Food safety decisions stay with the accountable human. No control command is permitted.
aiUseCases.nextValidationAction: Replay three months of alarms and measure how many ranked items were already known.

aiUseCases.name: Fulfilment load explanation
aiUseCases.raiNotes: Keep output at store and hour level, not individual picker level.
aiUseCases.humanInTheLoop: Operations reviews before any rota change.
aiUseCases.nextValidationAction: Check the model against one quarter of actual picking hours.

partnerRoles.name: Retail analytics specialist
partnerRoles.role: Supplies the counting and conversion method.
partnerRoles.validationQuestion: Which analytics supplier is already in the stores?

partnerRoles.name: Store systems integrator
partnerRoles.role: Joins POS, order and rota systems.

partnerRoles.name: Retail managed services partner
partnerRoles.role: Runs multi-site monitoring and engineer despatch.

industryContext.name: Manufacturing & industrial facilities
industryContext.definition: Production sites where throughput, quality, energy and safety are managed together, and where operational technology is separated from corporate IT.
industryContext.scopeNotes: Covers discrete and process plants. Control systems stay out of scope for any automated action.

pressures.statement: Short repeated stoppages often remove more available production time than reported large failures.
Historian, maintenance and energy data are rarely joined, so energy per good unit is hard to attribute.
Any change near control systems carries a safety and availability risk that outranks efficiency.

industryValueStreams.name: Convert plan into output
industryValueStreams.description: How a production plan becomes good units on the constraint asset.

industryValueStreams.name: Maintain asset reliability
industryValueStreams.description: How condition information becomes planned maintenance instead of a breakdown.

industryValueStreams.name: Manage energy and utilities
industryValueStreams.description: How energy is attributed to lines, assets and units produced.

industryValueStreams.name: Assure safety and compliance
industryValueStreams.description: How safety and environmental obligations are evidenced on site.

customerReportExtracts.statement: Reliable throughput and capacity utilisation are named as operating priorities.
Cost per unit and energy intensity are described as efficiency targets.
Safety performance is reported as a standing board measure.

customerValueStreams.name: Constraint uptime recovery
customerValueStreams.description: Finding and explaining the repeated short stoppages that remove time from the constraint asset.
frictions: Micro-stops below a threshold are not recorded as losses
Shift handover loses the cause
opportunities: Count and group micro-stops by cause
Bring one grouped cause to the daily review
capabilityNeeds: Read-only historian extract
A stable asset identifier
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: OT integrator usually provides the historian extract route.
validationQuestions: What stoppage duration is currently recorded as a loss?
Which asset is the agreed constraint?

customerValueStreams.name: Condition to work order
customerValueStreams.description: Turning a condition alert into planned work before it becomes a breakdown.
frictions: Alerts arrive faster than the team can plan work
Backlog priority is set by the loudest line
opportunities: Rank alerts against production impact
Draft a work order for a planner to accept
capabilityNeeds: Condition and maintenance data joined by asset
A drafted work-order route with approval
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: Reliability managed service partner may already hold the planning route.
validationQuestions: Who sets maintenance priority today?
Is the asset register consistent between CMMS and historian?

customerValueStreams.name: Energy per good unit attribution
customerValueStreams.description: Attributing energy use to a line and to units produced so that an efficiency target means something.
frictions: Metering is at site level, not line level
Production counts and meter intervals do not align
opportunities: Align meter intervals with production counts
Report idle running separately
capabilityNeeds: Line-level metering or a defensible allocation method
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: Industrial engineering partner typically designs the allocation method.
validationQuestions: Is metering available below site level?
Which allocation method would finance accept?

customerValueStreams.name: Safe change and OT separation
customerValueStreams.description: Keeping any analysis or recommendation outside the control boundary, with a human change route.
frictions: Analysis tools are requested with write access by default
Segmentation exceptions accumulate
opportunities: Keep every agent read-only
Record a drafted recommendation, never a command
capabilityNeeds: Enforced read-only boundary
An auditable approval record
customerValueStreams.partnerRelevance: OT integrator and security partner hold the segmentation design.
validationQuestions: Which standard governs change near control systems on this site?
Who signs an OT change?

organisation.structureNote: Function names come from the supplied design pack. Site versus group authority is an assumption until confirmed.

functions.name: Plant director
functions.accountability: Owns site output, cost and safety.
validationQuestions: Does the site or the group own the improvement budget?

functions.name: Production / Quality
functions.accountability: Runs the lines and owns quality outcomes.
validationQuestions: Who chairs the daily production review?

functions.name: Maintenance
validationQuestions: Is maintenance planning centralised?

functions.name: EHS / Sustainability
functions.accountability: Owns safety, environmental and energy reporting.
validationQuestions: Who owns the energy target on site?

functions.name: OT / IT / Finance
functions.accountability: Owns the control boundary, data access and the investment case.
validationQuestions: Which team approves data leaving the OT network?

openQuestions: Which loss is largest and best evidenced?
validationQuestions: Is the plant director the sponsor, or group operations?

openQuestions: Which stoppages repeat on the same shift?
validationQuestions: How many lines does one manager hold?

decisions: Accept or reject a drafted work order
openQuestions: Which alerts have historically preceded a failure?
validationQuestions: Does an external reliability partner plan this work?

openQuestions: Can energy be attributed below site level?
validationQuestions: Is energy reporting owned on site or at group level?

openQuestions: What read-only pattern is already approved?
validationQuestions: Which standard is the site assessed against?

unknowns.unknown: No agreed OEE or energy baseline for the constraint asset.
unknowns.validationQuestion: Which production baseline does the site already report and trust?

unknowns.unknown: Asset identifiers may differ between historian and CMMS.
unknowns.validationQuestion: Is there one asset register shared by both systems?

unknowns.unknown: Approved read-only data route out of OT is unconfirmed.
unknowns.validationQuestion: What data egress pattern is already approved for this site?

unknowns.unknown: Metering granularity below site level is unknown.
unknowns.validationQuestion: Which lines, if any, are separately metered?

aiUseCases.name: Micro-stop cause grouping
aiUseCases.raiNotes: Grouping must not be used to assess individual operators. Output stays at asset and cause level.
aiUseCases.humanInTheLoop: Production review accepts or rejects each grouped cause.
aiUseCases.nextValidationAction: Replay one month of historian events and compare with the recorded loss log.

aiUseCases.name: Condition alert prioritisation
aiUseCases.raiNotes: No control action. A missed alert carries safety consequence, so ranking never suppresses an alert.
aiUseCases.humanInTheLoop: A planner approves every drafted work order.
aiUseCases.nextValidationAction: Backtest ranking against the last twelve breakdowns.

aiUseCases.name: Energy allocation explanation
aiUseCases.raiNotes: An allocation method is a modelling choice, so publish the method with the number.
aiUseCases.humanInTheLoop: Finance and EHS accept the method before any figure is reported.
aiUseCases.nextValidationAction: Compare two allocation methods on one line for one month.

partnerRoles.name: Industrial engineering or OT systems integrator
partnerRoles.role: Designs the read-only data route and the asset register alignment.
partnerRoles.validationQuestion: Which integrator holds the OT network today?

partnerRoles.name: Machine OEM specialist
partnerRoles.role: Explains asset behaviour and supports condition thresholds.
partnerRoles.validationQuestion: Which OEM supports the constraint asset?

partnerRoles.name: Industrial managed services partner
partnerRoles.role: Runs reliability planning and the work-order route.
